meta._comment: mode=drip posts the earliest unposted item once per run, at least drip_interval_minutes apart. Set an item's scheduled_at (UTC ISO8601, e.g. 2026-06-29T09:07:00Z) to pin an exact time instead. Drop the downloaded PNGs into images/ (preferred) or rely on image_url.

Most "remote" job ads tell you they're fake — if you know where to look.

2. "Remote-friendly" = actually hybrid, 3 days in
3. A timezone clause (EST/CET required)
4. No salary, no company detail, just urgency
5. Reposted every few weeks — a CV-harvest, not a real role
